text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after pivoting the rotation to 
serve as a companion for the overseas 
campaign...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before heading overseas, there was 
something I absolutely had to resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unease I felt right after the Japan 
Derby— Her bizarre obsession with Symboli 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to properly grasp the current 
situation regarding this matter.
choice_data_list: (First, I need to talk to Sirius...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering how I should bring it up, I 
opened LANE, and right then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A notification regarding the "Cancellation 
of Overseas Challenge" arrived from the 
staff member in charge of the overseas 
expedition program.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason was an injury Symboli Rudolf 
sustained during training due to fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Why you...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare say you won't admit it. 
Your weakness has been laid bare...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
............ I am truly sorry. My 
carelessness ended up causing trouble for 
you as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, with this injury, there's no way 
she will make it in time for this 
schedule—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, Never mind the cancellation for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You don't understand a damn thing. This 
disaster is nothin' but the result of your 
own arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You took on pointless extra work, lost 
your focus, and ended up injured?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sirius—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea, this isn't 
concern. This is—contempt.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Try to wear two pairs of shoes, and you 
end up carrying unwanted baggage—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I've simply…… just gotten weaker……!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Be quiet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You're not cut out to be at the top. 
Even if everyone else acknowledges you, I 
never will.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: She had more of that talent in the past.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Back then was better, huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You really hit where it hurts, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rush outside after Sirius Symboli. 
Worried about her losing her cool, I 
search frantically, and—

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Sirius-san's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was with the staff member in charge of 
the overseas expedition program.

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to take up your time, you two. I 
have an urgent matter I'd like to consult 
you on—

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
"It's still just an idea I'm mulling over 
on my own, but I wanted to check your 
thoughts on it first."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Get to the point quickly.

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, excuse me! Um—

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, Sirius-san, why don't you 
go overseas on your own?

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Saying it's because Rudolf-san's slot 
opened up... might make it sound bad, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you'd be able to take on overseas 
races not as a companion horse, but as the 
main contender. I feel that's hardly a bad 
offer.”
choice_data_list:
(It's not a bad offer, that's for sure. 
But……)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should I really take her on an overseas 
expedition in her current condition?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Checking on Sirius Symboli— she was 
staring blankly into empty space.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words seemed to just slip out of her 
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The path she was meant to walk— I will 
paint over it first.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll take every 'first in history' for 
myself. The second person to do it is 
completely worthless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed, glaring into the void with dark 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The objective is becoming completely 
different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she aimed to take on the world 
was because she wanted to become the most 
brilliant presence on Earth—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If there's no precedent, I'll carve one 
out myself. Someday, I'll shine 
brilliantly at the very pinnacle of this 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Treading Symboli Rudolf underfoot was by 
no means the objective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I realized, the color drained 
from my face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after the Japan Derby. At that time, 
her obsession with Symboli Rudolf had 
grown larger as her reason to move 
forward. That was precisely why I felt 
uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet right now—she has gone even further 
beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her obsession is beginning to consume her, 
threatening to devour even her original 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, all her goals will be 
supplanted by 'trampling'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that beautiful dream will 
vanish without leaving a single trace.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Looks like you've got 
something to say, pup.
choice_data_list:
You shouldn't be taking on an overseas 
challenge right now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words 'You are too obsessed with 
Symboli Rudolf' almost slip out of my 
mouth—but no matter how I look at it, 
saying that honestly right here would be a 
terrible move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She surely didn't mean anything bad by it. 
If she was doing it unconsciously, it 
wouldn't be easy to swallow those words 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worst case, our trust could completely 
break down. My mind raced, searching for 
alternative words to say—
choice_data_list: I... I can't say I'm fully prepared yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I have only prepared as a 
traveling companion. If I am to challenge 
overseas races, far more time will be 
needed for proper adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's your take, it doesn't 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I decide my own path. The choice belongs 
to me and me alone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to teach you thoroughly right 
at the start, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you have a problem with it, earn your 
right to speak. Those are the rules.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Though... don't expect any mercy from me. 
I'm going overseas."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll trample down... every last bit of it.
